subject: Invoice 482 due next Friday

subject: Please approve the access request today

subject: Meeting invitation: Tuesday at 10

subject: Your parcel is out for delivery

subject: The weekly technology newsletter
body: Welcome to our weekly newsletter. This week's news: new programming tools, industry announcements and reading recommendations. You received this because you subscribed. Unsubscribe at any time.

subject: Project Orion milestone update
body: The Orion project passed its design milestone. The engineering team completed the first deliverable and is now implementing phase two. This is a progress update, not a request for action.

subject: Support for our existing customer account
body: We have been your customer for three years. Our paid account is showing an error and we need help resolving the support ticket. Please respond with the next steps.

subject: Introducing our sales services
body: We have not spoken before. I found your business online and wanted to introduce our sales services. Would you be interested in hearing more? This is my first outreach to you.

subject: Ready to buy: please send a quote
body: We evaluated your software and are ready to purchase 50 licenses this month. Please send a price quote and arrange a product demo so we can finalize the purchase.

subject: Hello from the park
body: It was lovely seeing the ducks yesterday. The weather is beautiful. Just saying hello and sharing a happy memory.
